scenes.title: *Milestones* made easy
scenes.sub: Gross motor · fine motor · language · social

cards.title: First year
lines: Neck holding **3 m** · rolls over **5 m**
Sits without support **8 m** · stands holding on **9 m**

cards.title: After one
lines: Tricycle **3 y** · hops **4 y** · skips **5 y**

cards.title: Hands
lines: Reaches with both hands **4–5 m** · transfers **6 m**
Immature pincer **9 m** · mature pincer **12 m**

cards.title: Language
lines: 1–2 words **12 m** · 2-word phrases **2 y** · sentences **3 y**

cards.title: Social
lines: Social smile **2 m** · stranger anxiety **6–9 m**
Waves bye-bye **9 m** · parallel play **2 y**

items.text: Not sitting without support by **9 months**
No words by **16 months**, no phrases by **2 years**

scenes.title: Exam *pearls*
items: **DQ = developmental age ÷ chronological age × 100**; DQ **< 70** = delay
Correct for prematurity until **2 years** of age
Regression of milestones: always investigate (think **neurodegenerative / Rett**)

caption:
👶➡️🧒 Developmental milestones made easy | PG Notes · Growth & Development 01

🏃 Gross motor: neck holding 3 m · rolls 5 m · sits without support 8 m · stands holding on 9 m · walks alone 12–13 m · runs 18 m · tricycle 3 y · hops 4 y · skips 5 y

✋ Fine motor: bidextrous reach 4–5 m · transfers 6 m · immature pincer 9 m · mature pincer 12 m · scribbles 15–18 m · circle 3 y · cross 4 y · triangle 5 y

🗣️ Language: coos 3 m · babbles 6 m · 'mama' 9 m · 1–2 words 12 m · 2-word phrases 2 y · sentences 3 y

😊 Social: social smile 2 m · stranger anxiety 6–9 m · waves bye-bye 9 m · parallel play 2 y

🚩 Red flags: no social smile by 3 m · not sitting by 9 m · not walking by 18 m · no words by 16 m, no phrases by 2 y · hand preference before 18 m · loss of any milestone

⭐ Pearls: DQ = DA ÷ CA × 100, DQ < 70 = delay · correct for prematurity until 2 years · regression: always investigate

📚 Ref: Nelson, IAP, Ghai
